$comment: The single source for GooseWorks skill routing. Edit here, then run `node scripts/build-router.js` to rewrite the route tables in gooseworks/SKILL.md and collections/brand-growth/routes.json. CI fails when they drift.

domain_routes.when: Raw social post lists, engagement rankings or voices lists
Learn a reusable brand or author voice from blog posts or social writing
domain_routes.how: Fetch it with catalog_fetch, or `gooseworks fetch voice-card` in a terminal.

domain_routes.when: Static/image ads, including campaigns, more ads, winner variants, copy/font changes or rejected-image fixes
domain_routes.how: Fetch with catalog_fetch or gooseworks fetch; follow selection/review/quote gates. Stop creation if unavailable.

domain_routes.when: Change one ad already made in GooseWorks (an edit, a new size, its tags or rating), or save the customer's image as a template. New image ads: `make-static-ads`
domain_routes.how: Open it with catalog_fetch in a chat app, or the installed copy in a terminal.

domain_routes.when: Charts, infographics, slides, social graphics, branded visual designs from a style or format
domain_routes.how: Fetch it with catalog_fetch, or `gooseworks fetch goose-graphics` in a terminal.

domain_routes.when: Any **video**: a video ad from a style, an original video from a brief or a reference video, or a video already started
domain_routes.how: Explicit custom skips the picker; otherwise watch the reference, read the brand and compare style constraints.

domain_routes.when: Make **product photos**: studio, lifestyle, marketplace, social or on a model
domain_routes.how: Open it with catalog_fetch in a chat app, or the installed copy in a terminal.

domain_routes.when: Animate an approved static ad or product image
domain_routes.how: Fetch it with catalog_fetch, or `gooseworks fetch animate-image` in a terminal.

unrouted_entry_skills.make-custom-video: Keeps an explicit custom choice without a picker, studies its reference and checks custom support; fetching this entry alone does not enable production.
unrouted_entry_skills.goose-video-local: One line: a next_step that gives the kit command says who starts it.

brand_growth_routes.job: Grow the brand, get more customers or sales, or not sure where to start
Market size, trends, brand watch and launch positioning
Competitor research, battlecards, landing-page tools and post engagers
Who buys and why; prospect lists, lead enrichment and work contacts
Cold email and LinkedIn drafts, replies and an import file; you send
A campaign plan from a launch, budget or date
Launch, scale or pause paid ads
Subscriber email flows and broadcast drafts; you send
SEO audits, metrics, keyword gaps, topic clusters, page-set plans and AI visibility
Posts, articles, newsletters and one or more content briefs
Organic social research, posts, voices, calendar and drafts
